subject: Stirge
picture: One small stirge hanging from a single cave beam. Two bat wings as large simple shapes, four small feet, and one long thin needle snout. Calm all-ages coloring page. Simple stone room with a ceiling, a closed door, and large floor slabs. Not a dragon, not a swarm, not a tangle of extra wings. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
